messages:
Alex Chen: Hey folks :wave: I'm Alex — started last Monday (Mar 9). Quick q's about commuter & cards: 1) I haven't seen the commuter/transport stipend hit my expense card or payroll yet - is that an automatic deposit or a monthly reimbursement? 2) my company expense card still shows 'pending activation' in the Spend portal. Who should I ping to get this unblocked? Thanks!

Maya Patel: Welcome, Alex! :tada: Commuter stipend is processed monthly by Payroll. For cards: try Spend app -> Settings -> Activate first. If that doesn't clear, DM me and I'll escalate. For the stipend, please fill out the commuter form here: https://intra.redwood.com/forms/commuter (one-time set up). After we receive the form Payroll includes it on the next pay cycle after the cutoff (see below).

Rajiv Singh: Adding payroll details - cutoff for monthly commuter is the 5th of each month at 23:59 PT. If you started mid-month you'll typically see a prorated amount in the next run. Note: for US employees our commuter stipend is currently taxable and will show on your paystub as something like `COMM-TRN`. If you prefer reimbursements, keep transit receipts and submit via Expensify with category `Commuter`.

Sam Ortiz: Also a quick note on benefits enrollment: commuter eligibility ties to your benefits enrollment status in a few cases. New hires have 30 days to enroll; if your enrollment is pending the stipend might not be kicked off until enrollment is active. If anything looks off after the payroll hit, email benefits@redwood.com and we'll reconcile.

HR Bot: Reminder: New hire benefits enrollment window = 30 days from start date. Docs: https://intra.redwood.com/benefits/quickstart

Maya Patel: If your expense card still shows pending, please post a screenshot (blur any sensitive numbers) and your employee ID here or DM me. I'll loop in the card admin and @Rajiv for the payroll side. Also, small example of how it appears on a stub:

EARNINGS
COMM-TRN    01/15 - 02/14    $48.00

Rajiv Singh: FYI Alex - if we miss the cutoff this month we'll include the prorated amount on the following pay run. Payroll timeline: runs biweekly, deposits land 2 business days after the run.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone - that helps a lot. I'll try activating the card and send a screenshot if it stays pending. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
